title: fix(runtime): a no-organization job pull runs as the organization its writes are stamped with
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TXGmqFBaz1HvYDe4KoPn1w)_
Fixes #31823

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/objectql` gains `ObjectQL#systemWriteOrganization()`; the claim measured `no` before this public method existed (see Acceptance notes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：没有声明组织的定时同步任务（job 的 `pull`），每次运行前先问引擎"系统写入会落到哪个组织"，单组织安装上就带着这个组织去拉取。引擎新增一个只读方法 `systemWriteOrganization()`，答案和它自己做系统写入时的判定是同一套。
- 为什么改：这类任务的每一行写入本来就被盖上了安装里唯一的组织，但拉取时的上下文里没有组织，导入匹配查询带不上组织条件，在 `single` 姿态下每行扫全表。1 万行同步从 41.6 秒降到 8.9 秒。
- 风险与回滚：只有"单组织、任务未声明组织"这一种情况改变上下文；多组织、隔离/集团姿态、没有组织对象的组合都和以前一样，写入照旧被拒或照旧落库。声明了组织的任务、`body` 和 `handler` 形式不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts`（`resolveJobPullOrganization` 和 pull 的 run 闭包）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts`（`systemWriteOrganization` 与插入路径共用的判定）、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`（新的公开方法）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts`，预期 33 个测试全绿，其中真实引擎用例断言匹配查询为 `organization_id = ? and external_id = ?`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A `job` that declares no `organization` and runs a `pull` used to run the pull as `{ isSystem: true }`. Every write of that pull was still stamped with the install's organization (ADR-0131 D9, derived at write time on `single` with exactly one organization), but the import's match lookup had no organization to scope by, so on `single` (no tenant read scope, ADR-0131 D11) it scanned the target table once per row. After #31812, the lookup scopes by the context's `tenantId` when there is one; this PR gives this pull one.

1. **`packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts`**: the D9 decision half of `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` (posture in force, the memoised organization probe, whether `sys_organization` is registered, handed to core's `resolveSystemWriteOrganization`) moves into its own facet body, `MiddlewareAndContextFacet.systemWriteOrganization`. The insert calls it with the posture it has already read, so the insert path is unchanged and there is one assembly.
2. **`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`**: new public facade method `ObjectQL#systemWriteOrganization()`, resolving to core's `SystemWriteOrganizationDecision`, a one-line delegation (the facade gate holds). It writes nothing and refuses nothing; a probe outage propagates, as on the insert. The seat ruling asked to reuse the engine's assembly "if it is reachable from the runtime". It was private, so this method makes it reachable instead of re-assembling posture, probe and registry fact a second time in the runtime.
3. **`packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts`**: `resolveJobPullOrganization` (module-private). For the `pull` form only, once per run, before the pull reads or writes: a declared `organization` is used unchanged and the engine is not asked; otherwise the engine is asked, and `derived` makes the pull run as `jobExecutionContext(DERIVED_ID)`. `refuse` (walled posture, zero or several organizations), `no-organization-object`, and an engine without the method keep today's `{ isSystem: true }`, so the write-time refusal stays the one that speaks. A probe that throws is logged once at `warn` for that run, naming the job, mapping and error, and the run continues with today's context.

`body` and `handler` forms are unchanged (pinned). Whether they would gain anything: a `body` job's `ctx.api` writes are stamped the same way, but a body issues its own reads and has no shared match lookup that leans on `tenantId`, so the measured cost does not exist there. A `handler` gets `executionContext` as an envelope for its own code to use. Neither is named as a follow-up card; if a body or handler author needs the derived organization, that is a separate request.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts`, two new top-level `describe`s in the existing harness file (the harness gained an `engine` option that spreads methods onto its fake `ql`):
  - fake engine: `derived` puts the organization on the pull context and is asked once per run (two runs, two asks, none at schedule); CONTROL a declared organization is used and the engine is not asked; CONTROL `refuse` ×3 (ambiguous, no organization, walled) and `no-organization-object` keep `{ isSystem: true }` and say nothing; CONTROL an engine without the method keeps today's context; a throwing probe gives one warn naming the job and the run completes; CONTROL a `body` job and a `handler` job keep `{ isSystem: true }` and the engine is not asked.
  - real engine (`ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` better-sqlite3 `:memory:` + the real protocol + core's `runImport`, `single`): one organization: the pull context is `{ isSystem: true, tenantId: 'org_one' }`, both match lookups are `where organization_id = ? and external_id = ?` with `['org_one', key]`, rows are stored with `org_one`, and a second run updates instead of creating; CONTROL a declared organization reads and writes the same way without asking; CONTROL two organizations: the context stays `{ isSystem: true }`, the lookup has no `organization_id`, and both writes refuse with `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`, nothing stored. The `automation` service in this case runs the import step `connector-pull.ts` runs (`runImport` over the protocol under the pull's `context`, same options) with the records in hand, since `@objectstack/service-automation` is not a runtime dependency.
- `packages/objectql/src/system-write-organization.test.ts`, new `describe` for `ObjectQL#systemWriteOrganization`: one organization → `derived`, nothing written, and a following system insert is stamped with the same id on the same single probe (memo shared); several → `refuse` ambiguous; injected `group` / `isolated` → `refuse` walled with no probe; no provider and `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` → walled; lean composition → `no-organization-object`; a probe outage propagates.
- No existing test was edited apart from the harness option above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② differs from the claim.** The claim says `Clause-②: no`. Measured on the diff, `@objectstack/objectql` gains one public method, so the PR body and changeset say `yes (widening)`. Nothing an author or caller could send before is refused now. New public name for the seat: `ObjectQL#systemWriteOrganization` (in `open_questions`).
- **What a derived context changes beyond the lookup.** On `single` the engine adds no tenant scope to reads (ADR-0131 D11), and an organization-carrying system write is stamped with that organization, the same one D9 derived before. So the watermark read is unchanged and the rows land where they did. Two visible differences: hooks and automations the pull's writes fire (`runAutomations: true`) now see `tenantId` on their context, and a match no longer reaches a row whose `organization_id` is NULL (the #31812 rule: NULL is not an owner). On a certified `single` install every row carries the organization (ADR-0131 D1/D3).
- **`log once`.** Read as one `warn` per failing run (each run resolves once), not once per job lifetime. A probe outage also fails the pull's writes at the engine, so the warn is not the only signal.

## Verification

Head `e31d876f`: the fix (`b24cadb3`, `5796b1e9`, `27deb45d`), a merge of `origin/main` at `b6fa08e3` (`2a308851`), and one test-only commit for `check:test-source-alias` (`e31d876f`).

<details><summary>Measurement on main and timing (G9 shape)</summary>

Scratch measure (not committed): the real engine, `single`, one organization, `N` rows seeded through the engine as organization-less system writes, then a no-organization `pull` job scheduled through `scheduleAppArtifactJobs` whose import upserts the same `N` keys. Runtime source at `2e9121ed` (main, with #31812 merged at `8fca8f70`) vs this branch.

| | main `2e9121ed` | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| pull context | `{"isSystem":true}` | `{"isSystem":true,"tenantId":"org_one"}` |
| match lookup | ``select * from `po_item` where `external_id` = ? order by `id` asc limit ?`` | ``select * from `po_item` where `organization_id` = ? and `external_id` = ? order by `id` asc limit ?`` |
| SQLite plan | `SCAN po_item USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_po_item_1` | `SEARCH po_item USING INDEX uniq_po_item_organization_id_external_id (organization_id=? AND external_id=?)` |
| stored `organization_id` | all `org_one` | all `org_one` |
| 10,000 rows upserted | 41,566 ms (241 rows/s) | 8,930 ms (1,120 rows/s) |
| 200 rows upserted | 397 ms | 338 ms |

Both sides: `created=0 updated=N errors=0`. Shared-box wall clock under the verify lock.
</details>

<details><summary>RED on main, ablation</summary>

- RED: the new tests against `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts` restored from `2e9121ed` (tree only, then `git checkout HEAD --`): `Tests 3 failed | 30 passed (33)`. Failing: "derived: the pull context carries it, asked once per run", "a probe that throws is said once at warn…", and the real-engine "one organization…" (`expected [ { isSystem: true } ] to deeply equal [ { isSystem: true, tenantId: 'org_one' } ]`).
- Ablation (skip the derivation) through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor `return decision?.kind === 'derived' ? decision.organizationId : undefined;` → `return undefined;`, anchor x1 → x0, blob `0175ea79` → `6b12f08f`. `Tests 2 failed | 31 passed (33)`: "derived: the pull context carries it…" and the real-engine "one organization…". Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The runtime suite imports `app-artifact-handlers.ts` from source, so no rebuild or dist preflight leg.
</details>

<details><summary>Builds, tests, typecheck, lint</summary>

- Before the merge, under the lock: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build`, `typecheck` for `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/runtime`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` (`Test Files 580 passed (580)`, `Tests 11942 passed (11942)`) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (`Test Files 566 passed (566)`, `Tests 9171 passed | 19 skipped (9190)`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- After the merge of `origin/main` (no incoming commit touches `packages/objectql`, `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers*` or core's security files): `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'` (`Tasks: 81 successful, 81 total`), both typechecks, `system-write-organization.test.ts` (`Tests 46 passed (46)`) and the two job suites (`Tests 74 passed (74)`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. On `e31d876f`: runtime `typecheck` plus the two job suites again, `Tests 74 passed (74)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the five touched source and test files, and on `packages/objectql/src` + `packages/runtime/src` whole: exit 0 (neither package has its own lint script).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on `e31d876f`: 72 derived families, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: `72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. The earlier rounds needed `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` for `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and a full packages build for `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (both exit 3 until then), and `check:test-source-alias` asked for a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` in the edited job-pull suite (added in `e31d876f`).
- Full dogfood: not run (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
</details>
